title: Release audit: The session keeps unredacted engine text in memory. `show_state` assigns the raw
summary: Store the redacted form, or a hash, for comparison and deduplication, and never assign raw engine text to long-lived session attributes.
requirements: The session keeps unredacted engine text in memory. `show_state` assigns the raw joined state to `self.last_state`, and `idle_refresh` assigns raw `exc.message` to `self.idle_failure`; if engine output or an error contains key material, it remains in the client for the session, violating the requirement that secrets never appear in anything the client keeps.
